Shadow AI has grown to become a leading concern for cybersecurity professionals globally, and the UK's National Cyber Security Centre has called on businesses to crack down once and for all.

In a new briefing document published this week, the cyber agency urged enterprises to tighten up practices and tackle unapproved use.

Organizations need to act fast on this front, according to the NCSC. With new affordable tools entering the market, the shadow AI trend is "likely to be reinforced" unless new policies are introduced.
